name: date-tile
title: Date tile
description: The little calendar leaf: month, day and weekday in a small fixed-width square for event lists, deadlines and invoices, with today, past and range variants.
docs: A time element with the calendar day in dateTime; a screen reader hears the whole date. tone="today" inverts the tile and adds "Today" to what is heard; you decide what is today, so the server and the browser never disagree. A date-only string never shifts with the time zone.
